x: We thus led easily on the track events, but some closer competition was seen in the field contests. F. Grassau did 37ft. 8½in. in the Shot Putt, and C.

Our five field event championships saw some good performances, and here again soundness of effort predominated. F. Grassau was an absentee from the Shot Putt and Bill Sutton gained first place with 35ft. 3in.
Another strong man in the thirties was a blond German, Fritz Grassau, Shot and Discus. Another great thrower at that time was René Nowack (Austria).
